visual_synopsis: Five men sit in a circle on office swivel chairs in a bare cream-walled room, introduced by an on-screen caption reading LOS ANGELES, DEC.24, 2004, in a parody of a group therapy session. The sketch cuts through them one by one in close-up as each takes his turn confessing to the circle, growing more animated, until one man stands up and heads for the door while the rest gesture after him.
